verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhisaT sa(n)jog hai bhai bhai sa(n)jogee|

en.bdb: He, who has the opportunity of the glimpse of the Guru, is a fortunate person well aware of the virtues of love and awe.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat bairaag hai sukh sahaj arogee|

en.bdb: Adopting the renunciation in the form of Word consciousness, he residing in equipoise is free from all maladies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: man bach karam na bharam hai jogeesar jogee|

en.bdb: His mind, speech and actions are not engrossed in delusions and he is king of the yogis.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa peevanaa a(n)mirat ras bhogee|

en.bdb: He is the quaffer of the cup of love and remains merged in the delight of nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪੀ ਅਪਿਓ ਅਸੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran milai pee apio asogee ||3||

en.bdb: Drinking the elixir of knowledge, meditation and remembrance of the Lord, he has gone beyond all sorrows and sufferings.
